scripts.lint: pnpm --filter web lint && go vet ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal)"
scripts.update:golden: UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 pnpm --filter web exec vitest run src/lib/mock-backend/golden.test.ts && go test ./internal/mock/
scripts.format: pnpm --filter web format && gofmt -w cmd internal
scripts.build:go: go build -o bin/api ./cmd/api && go build -o bin/collector ./cmd/collector && go build -o bin/sflow-gen ./cmd/sflow-gen
